extracted.name: Buttermilk Substitute
extracted.description: Skip the trip to the store and learn How to Make Buttermilk at home with simple pantry ingredients, including dairy-free and vegan options!
ingredient_lines: 1 Tablespoon white vinegar ((or lemon juice) (15 ml))
instruction_lines: Pour the tablespoon of vinegar into a 1 cup measurer. Fill the rest of the 1 cup measurer with milk.
Gently stir and let the mixture sit for about 5 minutes. This will allow the milk to slightly curdle, giving it a buttermilk-like texture and taste.
